domain.description: The specialist domain that produced this finding.

severity.description: Impact level per the severity rubric (Blocker > High > Medium > Low > Info).

confidence.description: How certain you are (0.0–1.0). Do not emit findings below 0.50.

file.description: Repo-relative path to the file where the issue was found.

lineRange.description: Line range in the file, e.g. '42-58'. Omit only if the finding is file-wide.

title.description: One-line summary of the finding (≤120 chars preferred).

rationale.description: Why this is a problem: root cause, risk, and impact.

recommendation.description: Concrete, actionable fix or next step.

evidence.description: Short code snippet, log line, or reference proving the issue exists.

suggestedPatch.description: Optional unified-diff style patch showing the suggested fix.
